records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Ocean Transportation revenue increased $366.3 million, or 53.6 percent, during the three months ended June 30, 2022, compared with the three months ended June 30, 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Ocean Transportation: The Company’s container volume in the Hawaii service in the second quarter 2022 was 1.5 percent lower year-over-year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The decrease was primarily due to lower retail-related demand.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The decrease in interest expense for the three months ended June 30, 2022, compared to the three months ended June 30, 2021, was due to lower outstanding debt during the period.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Logistics: In the second quarter 2022, operating income for the Company’s Logistics segment was $23.1 million, or $10.2 million higher compared to the level achieved in the second quarter 2021.
